nodes.label: Carousel Icon
nodes.description: A Win95-style desktop icon for the goose art voting carousel feature. The SVG depicts a slideshow/photo gallery interface: a large rounded-rectangle frame (light blue fill) containing a landscape image area with a sky-blue background, a circular sun/orb element (top-left), and two layered mountain or hill silhouettes in green tones. Behind and to the right is a second overlapping panel with a dashed border, suggesting a stack of slides. The composition visually communicates an image carousel or slideshow viewer, consistent with its use as the toolbar/taskbar icon for the GooseOS voting carousel window.
